## Coaching Points

- Avoid swinging the body or legs when pulling up
- Concentrate on squeezing the shoulder blades together to achieve a full range of motion
- Engage the core throughout the entire range of motion

## 4b. Standing Low Row

Exercise Objective: Develop the muscles of the upper back as well as the stabilizers of the legs and core
